privilegiez-la-communication-ecrite.texte: Written messages help avoid misunderstandings and can serve as evidence if needed.

formuler-sans-attaquer.texte: Describe the facts, then the effect on the child. Avoid judgments about the other parent.

horodater-toujours.texte: A message, a photo, a document: file it in the vault the same day.

prevenir-les-transitions.texte: Tell your child 48 hours before a custody change. Rituals are reassuring.
